profile.title: PROFESSIONAL PROFILE
description: I'm a Frontend Engineer with 4 years of experience developing modern, responsive, and scalable web applications, specializing in Angular, TypeScript, HTML5, and SCSS.

I have contributed to the development and maintenance of high-traffic applications, transforming Figma designs into pixel-perfect interfaces, implementing Design Systems, and building reusable components that ensure visual consistency, maintainability, and scalability.

I have experience collaborating closely with UX/UI and development teams in agile environments using SCRUM, applying frontend architecture best practices, clean code principles, and UI/UX issue resolution to enhance the overall user experience.

I have expanded my skills into Full Stack Development through personal projects using Node.js, Express, MongoDB, Mongoose, and REST APIs. These include developing and deploying a Full Stack application with Angular 21, integrating a REST API, MongoDB Atlas, and production environment configurations. I'm passionate about building high-quality digital solutions with clean, reusable, and maintainable code.
I'm currently strengthening my backend development skills, complementing my Angular expertise and progressively expanding my capabilities as a Full Stack Developer.
